basics.name: John Walley
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 20+ years of experience building sophisticated, high-performance applications and developer tools, with deep expertise in TypeScript, React, data visualisation, and browser-based UI engineering. Experienced designing complex interfaces for expert users, creating reusable libraries and abstractions, and solving performance-intensive problems across large, stateful datasets. Strong background spanning frontend architecture, APIs, developer tooling, high-performance computing, and financial systems, with a track record of taking technically demanding products from design through to production.

work.name: Cambridge Intelligence
work.summary: Senior engineer working on high-performance browser-based visualisation products for exploring large-scale graph, temporal, and geospatial data.
highlights: Designed frontend architectures and developer-facing APIs for interactive graph, timeline, and geospatial visualisations operating over large, complex datasets.
Built and optimised sophisticated browser interactions involving large stateful data models and performance-sensitive rendering.
Influenced technical and product direction across rendering, state management, API design, and developer experience.
Designed tooling and abstractions that reduce complexity for developers building and extending data visualisation applications.
Worked closely with product and design to turn complex analytical workflows into powerful, usable interfaces for expert users.

work.name: Mulberry House Software
work.summary: Founded and led a consultancy building sophisticated data-driven applications, visualisation systems, and developer tooling, remaining hands-on across architecture, implementation, and product direction.
highlights: Created and maintained reusable open-source React UI and data visualisation libraries, including [Allotment](https://allotment.mulberryhousesoftware.com/) and [Pennant](https://pennant.vega.xyz/), with 200,000+ weekly downloads and production use by the [Vega](https://vega.xyz/) trading network.
Designed reusable APIs and abstractions for complex interactive interfaces, balancing flexibility, performance, and developer usability.
Designed and delivered full-stack applications and developer-facing tools across multiple industries, owning projects end-to-end from initial design through to production.
Developed an interactive floor-planning application in collaboration with [Reno](https://www.renovatewithreno.co.uk/), a UK home-renovation startup.
Designed and delivered data visualisation tools for the pensions industry in partnership with [Financial Canvas](https://www.financialcanvas.co.uk/).
Built and deployed production systems spanning browser applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, build tooling, and deployment pipelines.
Led technical delivery while growing a consultancy, combining hands-on engineering with architecture, client collaboration, and product decisions.

work.name: Redgate
highlights: Improved adoption and usability of a database deployment tool used in CI/CD pipelines through product and UX improvements.
Introduced in-product analytics to support data-driven product decisions and prioritisation.
Worked closely with users, UX, and engineering to identify problems and define and prioritise features.

work.name: Redgate
work.summary: Developed tooling to streamline SQL Server database deployment within release pipelines.
highlights: Built developer-facing tools and features to improve the reliability and usability of database deployment workflows in production environments.

work.name: Sungard
highlights: Contributed to a scalable framework powering high-performance financial risk analytics.
Developed a tracing JIT compiler enabling C# financial models to execute efficiently on GPUs.

work.name: Earlier Career
work.summary: Held engineering and research roles spanning financial services, high-performance computing, scientific computing, and developer tooling.
highlights: High Performance Computing Developer at Fidelity, working on computationally intensive systems in financial services.
Application Engineer at MathWorks, acting as UK technical contact for parallel computing tools and helping developers solve complex computational problems.
Research Scientist at QinetiQ, working on multi-sensor fusion, object tracking, and defence systems.
